source.risk_basis: MultiCharts modeled OHLC path excursions restricted to entry-through-exit, including entry and realized exit costs once. These are model estimates, not measured tick MAE/MFE or confidence bounds. Opening gaps and cost jumps can overshoot floors; intervening modeled crossings use the threshold price. Unobserved tick gaps, liquidity and queue effects are not reconstructed.
source.session_convention: CME Chicago session dates; zero-trade weekdays retained; no internal reselection or split
